title: Campaign: ReadyNeuro, patterns along the condition
abstract: Subcampaign of 'what new facts about human brain activity can ReadyNeuro reveal?'. Scope: Effects of the task or of events within the run. How it splits: Does the test use only the task label of a run, or the timing of events within the run (OpenNeuro events files)? It holds 4 leaf studies with first tests (task-space, timescale-task, event-hrf, prestim-state). No results yet.
